title: QuoteCheck Input
description: Compare supplier quotes from PDFs or structured JSON and return machine-readable price, quantity, and exception data.

quote_pdfs.title: Supplier quote PDFs
quote_pdfs.description: Upload at least two text-based supplier quote PDFs. Scanned PDFs requiring OCR are not supported in this MVP.

quotes.title: Structured supplier quotes
quotes.description: Optional JSON input for API and agent workflows. Use this instead of quote PDFs.
